items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yeah, he sure did, he wanted musical companionship and he wanted to hear what everybody had to say. That’s the way Gil was, he was one of the most giving individuals I think I ever met, just of himself and of letting everything in, wanting everything in new. He was still writing for Claude [Thornhill] and he was doing all those… you know incorporating bop into the band, and it was a good band, people like Gene Williams was in the band singing, it was a good band.
Yeah, Lee Konitz. He had some…
